name: Rosebud AI
tagline: Describe a game in plain language and play it — no-code, prompt-to-game.
description: A browser-based platform that turns natural-language descriptions into playable 2D and 3D games. Instead of writing scripts you describe scenes, rules and behaviors, and Rosebud generates the code, art and mechanics with real-time previews and instant deployment. It pairs AI-generated visuals with templates and curated assets, and lets creators publish, share and monetize what they build.
insight: Started as an AI photo and avatar generator before pivoting to a no-code, prompt-to-game creation platform.
edge: Describe a game in plain language and it generates playable 2D or 3D code, art and mechanics in-browser, with built-in monetization.
cons: Browser-only, web games not native builds
Commercial rights need a paid plan
Output suits prototypes more than large titles

references.title: Rosebud AI x Marble: from world generation to multiplayer
